Vendored stb_image.h (v2.30) and stb_image_write.h (v1.16) from
https://github.com/nothings/stb/tree/f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5

These provide PNG/JPEG/BMP input and PNG/BMP output. No network fetch is needed
to build. Their full public-domain/MIT dual license is included in each header.
Only image codecs come from stb; scheduling, configuration and drawing are local.
